human_repair_overrides.content: \nFrom the listed cohort records, select only sample IDs whose final digit is even instead of selecting by BLM Mutation Status and Status.
On their displayed candidate rows, retain records with In_CHIP = True instead of filtering by Zygosity.
Apply the VAF rule, then search Classification rather than Sequence Ontology for UTR terms.
